definition: Intimation means an indirect hint or suggestion.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word intimation. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know intimation should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: A ring around the moon was the crew's only intimation of the gale still a day out.
A hint goes further than an intimation — a hint wants to be caught; an intimation barely troubles the surface, and missing it is no failure.
A declaration goes much further than an intimation — nothing indirect is left in it; the thing is simply said, in full, on the record.

An inkling is the faint idea that forms inside you — a first vague sense that something is coming. An intimation is the outward signal that plants that idea: a small sign out in the world rather than a feeling in your head. No sign, no intimation.

A whisper is a hint passed quietly from person to person — someone chooses to pass it along, however softly. An intimation need not come from anyone on purpose: a look, a habit, a light left on can give one off without a word being spoken.

The survey team almost drove past the field.
From the road it was ordinary wheat, but the drone photos showed a stripe where the stalks grew paler and a hand shorter, running in a perfect rectangle.
